meta.coverage: Q1 FY22 (Apr-Jun 2021) to Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026), 21 quarters. Q2 FY27 results are not yet out (due by 14 Nov 2026). Annual data for FY22-FY26 is in 'annual_reports'.
meta.units: INR crore unless stated; MT = million tonnes; MW = megawatt (AC unless noted)
important_caveats: Figures were compiled from press and exchange-filing coverage of each quarterly result, not by parsing the original BSE/NSE PDF filings. Verify against filings before relying on them for investment or audit work.

Coal India restated several prior-period figures (stripping-activity adjustment; and from Q4 FY26 a gross presentation of revenue from operations). Where both the as-originally-reported and the restated figure were found, both are stored.

Revenue series break: from Q4 FY26 revenue from operations is on a higher (gross) basis. Q4 FY25 comparative moved from 37,824.54 to 43,961.56 and Q1 FY26 from 35,842.19 to 42,919. Do not compare Q4 FY26 / Q1 FY27 revenue with older quarters without adjusting.

'pat_attributable_cr' is profit attributable to owners of the company; 'pat_consolidated_cr' is total consolidated profit (includes non-controlling interest) where the two were distinguishable. Outlets often mix the two, so small differences between sources are expected.
null = value not found in the sources reviewed.

Annual-report data: compiled from results, investor presentations, AGM summaries and press coverage, not from the annual report PDFs themselves. FY26 production and offtake are reversed in one source (see annual_reports.years[FY26]); the version used matches the other sources.
Dividend totals per year are derived from an aggregator's ex-date list, except FY23 and FY25 which are confirmed by Business Standard and FilingReader respectively.

quarterly_financials.notes: PAT up ~53% YoY; below analyst estimate of 3,805.
Value is the year-ago comparative published with Q2 FY23 results. PBT 3,643.24; total expenses 20,424.52.
Total income is the year-ago comparative (Rs 290.86 bn) published with Q3 FY23 results.
Net sales 30,046.25; PBT 9,335.27. Total income from the Q4 FY23 results comparative. FY22 PAT approx 17,378 (Rs 173.78 bn).
Results announced 10 Aug 2022. PAT roughly triple the year-ago 3,174.
Net sales 27,538.59 (+29% YoY); PBT 7,687.48. Revenue from operations is the comparative given with Q2 FY24 results.
Consolidated sales 32,429.46. Revenue from operations is the comparative given with Q3 FY24 results.

PAT fell ~18% on wage provisions as originally reported; restated Q4 FY23 PAT of 6,875.07 appears as the comparative in Q4 FY24 results. FY23 original PAT ~28,125; restated ~31,723-31,763. Net sales 35,161.
Original PAT 7,941 (-10% YoY); restated 10,528.03 per Q1 FY25 comparative. One source gives the year-ago revenue as 35,893.21.
Original PAT 6,814 (+13% YoY); restated 8,048.64 per Q2 FY25 comparative. Offtake is the comparative from Q2 FY25 results.
Described as a record Q3 profit at the time; restated figure 10,253.48 is the Q3 FY25 comparative.
EBITDA margin 30.3%. Revenue comparative restated to 38,213.48 in Q4 FY25 results. FY24 PAT 37,369-37,402 depending on source (restated quarters sum to 37,402).
PBT 14,147.21. Offtake figure from a headline reference to 'coal supplies at 198.5 MT'.
Sales 27,271.30 (-9% YoY). Dividend of 15.75 is as stated by one outlet.
Net sales 32,358.98.
Original revenue 37,824.54; restated (gross basis) 43,961.56 per Q4 FY26 comparative. FY25 PAT original 35,302.10, restated 35,505.78. Production is the comparative in Q4 FY26 coverage.
Revenue restated to 42,919 (gross basis) in Q1 FY27 comparative. PBT 11,709. Production -3% and offtake -4% YoY. Results date 31 Jul 2025.
Weakest quarter in the window. Minister attributed the fall to heavy September rainfall. EBITDA margin 22.2%. Some aggregators wrongly show 6,289 (that is Q2 FY25). Results date 29 Oct 2025.
A one-time provision for executive pay-scale upgradation was cited as a drag. 9M FY26 PAT 20,163 vs 25,709. Results date 12-13 Feb 2026.

REVENUE ON NEW GROSS BASIS (series break). PBT 14,626.75; other income 5,128 (+30%). FY26 PAT attributable 31,094.29 vs 35,505.78 (-12%). FY26 revenue shown as 168,400 on the new basis. Production 239 MT as reported in one source; treat as approximate. Results date 27-28 Apr 2026.

Revenue on new gross basis (vs 42,919 restated Q1 FY26, +7.8%). EBITDA margin compressed ~306 bps. Operating profit about 12,069 per one data aggregator. Capex 3,399. First energy-sales revenue (5.68 cr standalone solar segment). One aggregator (Univest) shows PAT 8,609 and prior-year revenue 35,842; excluded as inconsistent with the filing-based figures. Results date 27 Jul 2026.
